name: regress
expr: [b, bint, r, rint, stats] = regress(y, X);
comment: Sig: [b, bint, r, rint, stats] = regress(y, X[, alpha]). OLS multiple regression via Cholesky on X'X. stats = [R^2, F, p_F, sigma^2]. DEEP-PROBE c164: the 4th output rint (residual confidence intervals for outlier detection) was the TEXTBOOK formula r +/- t*sigma*sqrt(1-h_ii) with nu dof, which DISAGREED with MATLAB. MATLAB R2025b uses the Chatterjee & Hadi (1986, eq.14) / Belsley-Kuh-Welsch (1980, eq.2.26) LEAVE-ONE-OUT variance estimate: sigma_i = sqrt(max(0, nu*s2/(nu-1) - r_i^2/((nu-1)(1-h_ii)))), ser = sqrt(1-h_ii)*sigma_i, t = tinv(1-alpha/2, nu-1). Now bit-exact: rint(1,:)=[-0.5423713822 0.6623713822], rint(3,:)=[-0.5217414236 0.8817414236], rint(5,1)=-0.4510083996. b/bint/r/stats unchanged. covers:[regress].
